title: automation: a refused flow resume answers status-derived codes (VALIDATION_ERROR / RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND) instead of INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT / INVALID_SIGNAL / RUN_NOT_FOUND
body:
QA-source: #21720 · automation.trigger-status-contract · acceptance[4]

Found by the 17.7 pre-release run #21720 (subject `251a7dd4`); clauses A5, A6 and A7 of `automation.trigger-status-contract` (rev 1) fail. Verifier V3 re-derived it on two fresh boots: CONFIRMED, P2. Not a 17.7 regression — the behaviour predates 17.6.0.

## Reproduction (stock showcase, admin)

1. `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_reassign_wizard/trigger {"recordId":"{any showcase_task id}"}` → 200 with `runId`.
2. `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_reassign_wizard/runs/{runId}/resume {"inputs":{}}` → **400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`** ("Invalid screen input: … required"). Expected `INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT`.
3. Same route, `{"inputs":{"new_assignee":"x"},"output":{"$User":{}}}` → **400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`** ("… reserved by the flow engine"). Expected `INVALID_SIGNAL`.
4. `POST …/runs/run_nope/resume {"inputs":{"new_assignee":"x"}}` → **404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`** ("No suspended run 'run_nope'"). Expected `RUN_NOT_FOUND`.
5. Trigger a scratch screen flow, `DELETE` the flow, resume its run → **404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`** ("Flow '…' not found for run …"). Expected `RUN_NOT_FOUND` (A6).
6. After each refusal `GET /api/v1/data/sys_automation_run/{runId}` is still `paused`, and a valid resume then succeeds — the statuses and the suspension semantics are right; only the code is lost.

Consequence: a caller cannot tell `INVALID_SIGNAL` from `INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT`, and `client.automation.resume()` rejects with `err.code` `VALIDATION_ERROR` / `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, never the documented codes (A7). The same door does put a specific code on the wire when one is supplied (a resumed-then-failed run answers `FLOW_FAILED`).

## Mechanism

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts:2108`: the resume-refusal rows return `{message, status}` with no `details.code`; the interface comment at `:2013-2016` says the builder then derives the code from the status, and `packages/spec/src/api/errors.zod.ts:187` maps 400 → `VALIDATION_ERROR`, 404 → `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`.
- The unit pin `http-dispatcher.test.ts:629-640` asserts only `.not.toBe('FLOW_FAILED')`, which is why this went unnoticed.

## What declares the codes

- Client and runtime CHANGELOG 17.1.0 (`bc6434b`): "every refusal that leaves the suspension intact keeps its own code".
- `client.automation.resume()` JSDoc (`packages/client/src/index.ts` ~5766): "keep their own codes".
- `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx:920`: refused "with `code: 'INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT'`".
- The error-code ledger registers `INVALID_SIGNAL`, `RUN_NOT_FOUND`, `RESUME_IN_PROGRESS`, `STORE_UNAVAILABLE` under `@objectstack/service-automation` (`packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts:1059,1075-1077`). `INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT` is not in the ledger (only in `TriggerFlowResponseSchema` / `AutomationResult.code`).

## Done when

The four refusals carry their engine codes on the wire (and `INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT` is registered), with a pin asserting the code, not its absence.
